purpose: The ONE acceptance rule for complaint detection. Consumed by tools/admission.py (second model), tools/run_evals.py --gate standing-send, the claims matrix (C9.4, A19) and specification §9.5. Replaces complaint_keywords.acceptance_test and the complaint floors of evals/model_admission.json (v1.8).

method.bound: one-sided exact binomial (Clopper-Pearson) upper confidence bound on the miss rate
method.not: the upper end of a two-sided 95% interval (that equals a one-sided 97.5% bound)
method.family: path: the confidence applies to the whole acceptance path of one candidate version; each attempt uses alpha_attempt = (1 - path_confidence) / max_attempts_per_version (Bonferroni, valid without assuming the attempts are independent)
method.assumptions: fixed, pre-registered dataset per attempt; messages drawn from the pilot population; labels by two independent annotators; the tuning/development data never enters an acceptance attempt

notes.zero_total_misses: NOT a criterion since v1.8. A non-critical miss is judged by the bound; a critical miss fails the attempt.
notes.per_category: critical_misses_max is a test condition on the sample, not a population guarantee: 0 misses in 5 legal complaints only bounds that category's miss rate below ~45% (one-sided 95%). Per-category bounds are reported, not gated.
notes.min_complaints: 60 is the smallest n for which 0 misses meets 6% at the per-attempt confidence 97.5% (0/60 -> 5.96%). A single non-critical miss needs n >= 91.
